newsitem.title: USA: CACI International stake cut by group.
newsitem.headline: CACI International stake cut by group.

text.p: A group led by Parsow Partnership Ltd said Wednesday it cut its stake in CACI International to 373,000 Class A common shares or 3.5 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 231,500 additional shares between December 6 and January 17 at prices ranging from $20.70 to $22.95 per share.

CACI, of Arlington, Va., provides a wide range of international professional and high-technology services and products in support of national defense agencies, aerospace, communications, energy and transportation, among others.
